jobs.title: IT Risk Analyst Officer
jobs.company: DOKU, PT NUSA SATU INTI ARTHA
jobs.description: Job Title: IT Risk Analyst About The Role: This position responsible to safeguard the integrity of DOKU’s financial and technological risk framework by planning and executing detailed internal, third-party vendor, and data privacy risk assessments. This role ensures that DOKU’s payment products, IT infrastructure, and business processes strictly align with regulatory mandates (BI, OJK, UU PDP) and global security standards (PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2). What Will You Do: Execute scheduled IT risk assessments using standardized checklists and templates across DOKU’s IT products, infrastructure, and operational processes in alignment with BI, OJK, ISO 27001, and PCI-DSS guidelines. Collect control evidence and perform preliminary gap checks for internal IT teams based on ISO 27001 checklists and PCI-DSS Targeted Risk Analysis (TRA) templates for review by the IT Security Manager. Administer standardized third-party vendor security questionnaires, verify completeness of submitted compliance certificates (ISO 27001, PCI-DSS), and escalate missing controls prior to vendor onboarding. Assist in conducting Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA) by mapping data flows and compiling privacy compliance checklists against UU PDP and GDPR requirements for supervisory validation. Coordinate and compile responses to enterprise merchant, partner, and regulatory security questionnaires using pre-approved knowledge bases, escalating non-standard technical queries to senior team members. Maintain and update the enterprise IT Risk Register, log approved Risk Treatment Plans (RTP), track remediation due dates, and escalate overdue action items to the IT Security Manager. Support internal and external audit executions (ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, regulatory) by gathering, organizing, and indexing required risk documentation and audit evidence. What we are looking for: Bachelor’s Degree (S1) in Information Technology, Computer Information Systems. 1- 3 years of experience as an IT Security Risk Analyst or IT Risk/Compliance Specialist, with a strong preference for candidates from the payment gateway, fintech, or financial services industry. Soft Skill Requirements: Translational Communication : Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to translate complex compliance and security requirements into clear, actionable steps. Attention to Detail & Analytical Rigor : Meticulous eye for detail when reviewing technical controls, vendor evidence, audit artifacts, and cross-departmental SOPs. Collaborative Initiative : Proactive, self-driven team player capable of building constructive working relationships across technical, commercial, and operational teams Technical Skill Requirements: Security & Compliance Frameworks : Solid working knowledge and practical application of ISO 27001, PCI-DSS (including Targeted Risk Analysis), SOC 2, ISO 31000, and familiarity with ISO 22301, ITIL, and COBIT. Fintech Regulatory & Privacy Mastery : Practical understanding

jobs.title: Telecommunications Enginer / Cybersecurity Enginer
jobs.description: Role Description The Telecommunications Engineer / Cybersecurity Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining, and securing communication networks and IT infrastructure to ensure reliable connectivity and protection of digital systems. The role involves configuring network equipment, monitoring telecommunications performance, troubleshooting connectivity issues, conducting security assessments, and implementing effective cybersecurity measures. Responsibilities also include managing network infrastructure, identifying potential security vulnerabilities, supporting incident response activities, maintaining system documentation, and ensuring compliance with relevant technical and security standards. The position requires collaboration with IT, network operations, and security teams to strengthen infrastructure reliability and protect organizational information assets. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. Strong understanding of telecommunications systems, network architecture, and cybersecurity principles. Knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, firewalls, and network protocols. Familiarity with network monitoring, security assessment, and vulnerability management tools. Understanding of information security standards, access controls, and incident response procedures. Familiarity with cloud security, encryption technologies, and network protection systems. Ability to troubleshoot network issues and identify potential security risks. Strong analytical, technical, and problem-solving skills. Good communication and collaboration abilities when working with technical teams. Commitment to network reliability, information security, and continuous technical improvement.
